messages:
Kai: hey folks, kai here (data infra)  day 1! i'm trying to pull a prod snapshot of feature flags to correlate with an incident but Console returns 403 on /admin/flags. who do i ask for read-only access or a quick JIT token?

Marta: welcome @Kai :wave: for read-only views we have the ff-auditors role. toggles require ff-operators. do you need to change anything or just read audits/state?

Kai: only read + recent audit lines to map to event ids. planning a one-off script run, expiry ~90m.

Rohit: quick path: open a Linear with purpose and expiry, @marta or i can sponsor a JIT. if you plan to automate nightly runs later, ask for CI-triggered JIT or a short-lived service token (security prefers JIT).

access-bot: Access template: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/access-requests. Category: "service-account-readonly" or "jit-elevation".

Kai: filed ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-9001  body: "snapshot prod flags for incident correlation; expiry 90m; owner: kai@redwood"

Marta: sponsoring now. small reminder: approvals include MFA and are audited. paste the curl you used so ops can reproduce the 403 if needed.

Kai: original curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/admin/flags
# response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":"FF_NO_ACCESS"}
```

access-bot: JIT created: JIT-9001. Approver: Marta. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-9001

Marta: approved. Kai granted ff-auditors-prod for 90 minutes. Audit ref: AUD-2026-03-22-9001

Kai: can access now, pulled flag states + audit lines, saved snapshot and attached to PROD-9001. will not toggle anything.

Rohit: great. when you attach the snapshot, include the audit ref and timestamps. if this becomes recurring, let's chat about CI-triggered JIT vs scoped service token.

Kai: added notes + audit id. thanks all for the speedy help  excited to be here! :tada:
